name: auth-6
title: Forgot Password Request
description: Forgot-password card that validates an email, then switches to a check-your-inbox confirmation with a use-another-email option and back-to-sign-in link.

standards.purpose: Let a locked-out user start account recovery without revealing whether an address exists.
useWhen: A user cannot sign in and needs a recovery link.
doNotUseWhen: The product has no verified email channel.

rules.check: The response is identical whether or not the address exists.
One email field and one action; do not mix sign-in and recovery in the same card.
